segmentation.rationale: Segmentation/tapering targets lower scattering and better heat confinement; values are design targets consistent with reported PCM nanostructuring trends.

assumptions: Linear mixing of effective index/absorption vs crystallinity fraction (first-order).
Mode overlap and loss coefficients are design-estimate placeholders to be calibrated by FDTD/FEM and measurement.
Energy estimates are normalized conceptual values proportional to effective switched volume and fraction.
Material indices from project spec: Sb2S3 amorphous 2.70, crystalline 3.30; read at 1550 nm conceptually.
references_context: Nanostructured/tapered PCM for low loss and endurance (arXiv 2604.08637)
